summary: Visual-redesign + rename iteration (Part A/B/C) end-to-end verified against live preview https://aegis-rmf-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend regression clean: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -c pytest.aegis.ini tests -q` -> 85/85 pass (43.4s); `pytest -c pytest.aegis.ini tests/acceptance -q` -> 12/12 pass (23.3s). Part A security headers verified via `curl -I /login`: CSP present with fonts.googleapis.com + fonts.gstatic.com + frame-ancestors ('self' https://*.emergent.sh https://*.emergentagent.com https://emergent.sh for dev preview); x-content-type-options nosniff; referrer-policy no-referrer; permissions-policy camera=(),microphone=(),geolocation=(),payment=(),usb=(). GET /metrics -> 404 (does NOT fall through to SPA); GET /api/v1/metrics -> 200 Prometheus text. Static check /app/frontend/deploy/nginx.conf confirmed: `location = /metrics { return 404; }` and production CSP uses `frame-ancestors 'none'` + font/style allowances for Google Fonts, plus X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, all `always`. Part B rename verified: document.title='IronVision AI'; login-brand data-testid present with 'IronVision AI'; hero tagline 'INTELLIGENT RISK. CONTINUOUS ASSURANCE.' visible; brand-logo data-testid visible; dev picker 'Switch user (dev only)' with 8 synthetic accounts and provider label 'dev_password' + 'DEVELOPMENT AUTHENTICATION – SIMULATED, NOT CAC/PIV' banner. After login (issm) header contains brand-title='IronVision AI', brand-tagline, dev-auth-indicator, current-user-name (Marcus Hale), roles chip (ISSM · org +4 system roles), notification-bell, theme-toggle-btn, header-switch-user-btn, header-logout-btn - ALL present. Text scan 'AegisRMF' NOT present on /login, /portfolio, /systems, /evidence-sources, /controls, /inheritance, /policy-auditor, /poams, /reviews, /evidence-ledger, /emass-sync, /mapping-review, /audit-log, /rmf-workflow (both dark + light theme). OSCAL export (POST /api/v1/systems//oscal/poam as isso) returns validation.valid=true AND payload contains the string 'IronVision AI' (metadata remark) with zero occurrences of 'AegisRMF'. Part C design system: theme-toggle-btn flips html.dark class and persists to localStorage.ironvision.theme='dark'/'light'; survives page reload. RMF Workflow page has 11 stage-* data-testid cards with visible hover-lift styling. Workbench status badges (IMPLEMENTATION/ASSESSMENT/MONITORING/EVIDENCE FRESHNESS) render with small label prefix + icon + colored pill text (planned=gold, not assessed=gray, failing=red, current=emerald). CAT I/II/III and LOW/MODERATE/HIGH badges render consistently. CM-6 control-detail drawer closes with Escape (verified: drawer DOM node absent after Esc). Portfolio/Leadership page as leadership.viewer renders full dashboard (3/4 authorized, trend chart, waiting-on-your-decision tiles) with no AegisRMF leakage. Logo system: brand-logo loads logo.svg in both themes; dark theme shows white/mono variant on login hero. Phase 5 banner 'Phase 5 · Production Hardening · Synthetic tenant only' at sidebar bottom.

issues: Benign CSP console warnings: Emergent-injected https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js and a blob-worker (replay canvas capture) are blocked by the SPA CSP because script-src/worker-src do not include 'cloudflareinsights' or 'blob:'. This is Emergent platform telemetry injected at the ingress layer, not application code; it does not affect any user-visible functionality but will show as 2 red lines in devtools on every page. Low priority - consider whitelisting static.cloudflareinsights.com in script-src and 'blob:' in worker-src ONLY if you want a clean devtools console; otherwise leave as-is (stricter is better).

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/craco.config.js (dev) + frontend/deploy/nginx.conf (prod) both correctly 404 /metrics so the SPA fallback never hides a potentially sensitive metrics endpoint; /api/v1/metrics is the only exposed Prometheus surface. Verified live.

CSP on /login (dev) and in nginx.conf (prod) both include fonts.googleapis.com (style-src) and fonts.gstatic.com (font-src) which is required for Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter. Prod uses frame-ancestors 'none' (correct hardening); dev relaxes to emergent.sh / emergentagent.com so the preview iframe works. No unsafe-eval in prod script-src, which is appropriate; dev keeps 'unsafe-eval' for CRA/react-refresh. Clean separation.

ThemeContext: 'ironvision.theme' localStorage key + prefers-color-scheme fallback on first mount + html.dark class toggle is the standard Tailwind dark pattern, verified round-trip (toggle -> reload -> class persists).

Rename sweep is complete: zero 'AegisRMF' occurrences in rendered UI across 14 traversed pages and both themes. Internal identifiers (aegisrmf.demo email domain, pytest.aegis.ini, test_phase5_security.py, aegis_http_request_duration_seconds metric, backend .env JWT_SECRET etc.) correctly left untouched per spec ('internal identifiers unchanged').
OSCAL metadata remarks now carry 'IronVision AI' while OSCAL validation still passes - good evidence that only user-visible strings were touched, schema untouched.

RMF workflow stage-* cards use interactive hover-lift; the dashboard stat cards (SYSTEMS AUTHORIZED / IN ASSESSMENT / ATO EXP / etc.) are visually static per spec. Separation of interactive vs. non-interactive card motion appears correct.

Minor: dark-mode toggle button has only an icon (sun/moon) with no visible aria-label text in the rendered DOM scan. The data-testid='theme-toggle-btn' is present and keyboard-focusable, but confirm it has aria-label='Toggle theme' or similar screen-reader text for WCAG AA. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Part A/B/C acceptance criteria verified on live preview

rca of the issue: No defects found. Visual redesign + rename acceptance met in full: headers hardened, /metrics isolated to API, every user-visible 'AegisRMF' replaced with 'IronVision AI', tagline preserved, logo & favicon system in place, light/dark theme with persistence works, status pills + implementation/assessment/monitoring/freshness badges + CAT I/II/III render per spec, Esc closes modal/drawer, RMF stage-* cards present, OSCAL export schema-valid with new brand remark, backend 97/97 regression green.
